name: Sampler
description: Denoises a latent with the model, following the conditioning: from noise for an Empty Latent or an Empty Video Latent (a clip), else from the latent given (a picture from VAE Encode, a clip from VAE Encode Video, or a sampled one), by the amount Denoise sets. A latent from VAE Encode with a mask is redrawn only where the mask is white; with Soft mask, gray in the mask is a strength.

inputs.name: guidance
inputs.label: Guidance
inputs.description: How closely to follow the prompt (CFG). 1 for distilled models such as Z-Image Turbo and FLUX.2 Klein, which also skips the negative prompt; about 5 to 8 for SDXL and SD 1.5.

inputs.name: flow_shift
inputs.label: Flow shift
inputs.description: How far a flow model's sigma curve is bent toward high noise. Unset: the model's own. FLUX.2 Klein's own scheduler (unset Scheduler) ignores it: use simple or discrete with it. 2.02 is ComfyUI's Klein value.

inputs.name: denoise
inputs.label: Denoise
inputs.description: For a latent from VAE Encode, VAE Encode Video or another Sampler: how far to move from it, 0 keeps it, 1 ignores it. An Empty Latent always starts from noise.

inputs.name: denoise_mode
inputs.label: Denoise mode
inputs.description: How Denoise below 1 is read for a start latent. Unset or noise_level: the start picture is mixed with noise to that level and the steps run from there. schedule_cut: ComfyUI's reading: the schedule is made int(Steps / Denoise) long and its last Steps steps run, so Steps are always run and the sigmas match ComfyUI's. Not for video; Denoise 0 is refused.

inputs.name: soft_mask
inputs.label: Soft mask
inputs.description: For a latent from VAE Encode with a mask: read the mask's gray as how much to change (differential diffusion): white is redrawn from the start, gray is held until later in the run, black is kept. Off: the mask is white or not. Not for an inpaint model, which has its own mask input. Needs this build's helper.

inputs.name: variation_strength
inputs.label: Variation strength
inputs.description: A small change on the same picture: the start noise of Seed is blended toward the noise of Variation seed by this much (spherical blend), 0 is the plain Seed, 1 is the Variation seed's own picture. Not for video. Needs this build's helper.

inputs.name: variation_seed
inputs.label: Variation seed
inputs.description: The seed whose noise the start noise is blended toward. The same as Seed counts as Seed plus 1. Needs this build's helper.
